description: This source file defines a static helper class 'ManageNavPages' containing constants and methods for managing navigation highlighting and active page tracking within the 'Manage' area of an ASP.NET Core MVC application, specifically used in views to determine which navigation item should be marked as active.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static helper class providing navigation page identifiers and methods to determine active navigation states within the 'Manage' section views.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'Index' page based on the current view context.

methods.name: ChangePasswordNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'ChangePassword' page based on the current view context.

methods.name: ExternalLoginsNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'ExternalLogins' page based on the current view context.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the 'TwoFactorAuthentication' page based on the current view context.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines if the given page is the active one by comparing it to the 'ActivePage' key in view data, returning 'active' or an empty string.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: Extension method to set the active page in the view data dictionary.
